name: M3_PMS100MI_UpdMatLine
description: Update material lines in an existing manufacturing order. This operation modifies one material line identified by facility, product number, manufacturing order number, and material sequence number. It can change the linked component item, quantity and units, warehouse and location, connection to an operation, waste and inheritance settings, issue method, lot number, attributes, and free-text descriptions. Typical uses are to reflect engineering changes, adjust consumption quantities, or change how and from where material is issued. The update is strictly validated against manufacturing order status, process type, reservations, allocations, and item/warehouse configuration, and is rejected if any control rule is violated.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order’s material line is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order whose material line is being updated.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number containing the material line to update.

inputParameters.name: MSEQ
inputParameters.description: Sequence number identifying the specific material line within the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the manufacturing order whose material line is updated.

inputParameters.name: OPNO
inputParameters.description: Operation number where the component on this material line is first used in the routing.

inputParameters.name: ACTS
inputParameters.description: Operation element number linking the material line to a specific operation element.

inputParameters.name: MTNO
inputParameters.description: Component number used on this material line.

inputParameters.name: DWPO
inputParameters.description: Drawing position corresponding to this component on the product drawing.

inputParameters.name: CNQT
inputParameters.description: Required quantity of the component according to the material line.

inputParameters.name: PEUN
inputParameters.description: Product engineering unit of measure used to express the component quantity in the bill of material.

inputParameters.name: FXCD
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of the manufacturing order quantity.

inputParameters.name: WAPC
inputParameters.description: Normal waste percentage applied to this component in planning and material reservations.

inputParameters.name: BYPR
inputParameters.description: By/co-product code indicating whether the component is a normal item, by-product, co-product, or main product.

inputParameters.name: CRTM
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component is treated as critical material in availability and planning checks.

inputParameters.name: SPMT
inputParameters.description: Issue method defining when and how the component is issued to the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse from which the component will be issued.

inputParameters.name: WHSL
inputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse from which the component will be issued.

inputParameters.name: LGTH
inputParameters.description: Length factor used together with width and other factors to calculate the component quantity.

inputParameters.name: WDTH
inputParameters.description: Width factor used together with length and other factors to calculate the component quantity.

inputParameters.name: LWF1
inputParameters.description: Additional factor 1 used in the material consumption calculation for this component.

inputParameters.name: LWF2
inputParameters.description: Additional factor 2 used in the material consumption calculation for this component.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific lot of the component to be used.

inputParameters.name: CMCD
inputParameters.description: Inheritance control setting defining whether lot number and/or attributes from this component are inherited by the manufactured item.

inputParameters.name: FMT1
inputParameters.description: Optional free-text description of the material on this line, used especially when no item master exists.

inputParameters.name: FMT2
inputParameters.description: Optional technical reference text associated with the material line.

inputParameters.name: ATNR
inputParameters.description: Attribute number identifying any configured attribute connected to this material line.

inputParameters.name: BFCW
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether backflush issue quantities for this component are based on catch weight.

inputParameters.name: AADM
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether components that are not defined in the item master may be added on this material line.

inputParameters.name: ADBF
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether detailed backflush transactions are created for this component when aggregated backflush is used.

inputParameters.name: ISTO
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component is handled as intermediate stock during manufacturing order reporting.

inputParameters.name: ALON
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component's location is treated as an allocatable location when issuing via picking list.
